description_en: Re-evaluates the compliance of resources based on a rule or compliance package
description_zh: 使该规则执行一次评估
kebab_example: aliyun config start-config-rule-evaluation --config-rule-id cr-bdb6626622af00120000 --revert-evaluation false --compliance-pack-id cp-ac16626622af00530000 --api-version 2019-01-08 --region cn-hangzhou
name: StartConfigRuleEvaluation

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the rule.

For more information about how to obtain the ID of a rule, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/169607.html
parameters.help_zh:
规则ID。

关于如何获取规则ID，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/169607.html
parameters.name: config_rule_id

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to reevaluate a non-compliant resource that is ignored. Valid values:

true: reevaluates a non-compliant resource that is ignored.
false: continues to ignore a non-compliant resource
parameters.help_zh:
是否恢复已忽略的评估结果。取值：

true：恢复已忽略的评估结果。

false：不恢复已忽略的评估结果
parameters.name: revert_evaluation

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the compliance package.

For more information about how to obtain the ID of a compliance package, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/263332.html.

You must set one of the `CompliancePackId` and `ConfigRuleId` parameters
parameters.help_zh:
合规包ID。

关于如何获取合规包ID，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/263332.html。

参数`CompliancePackId`和`ConfigRuleId`必须二选一
parameters.name: compliance_pack_id

Result.description_en:
Indicates whether the operation is successful. Valid values:

true: The operation is successful.
false: The operation fails
Result.description_zh:
规则执行结果。取值：

true：成功。

false：失败
